description: Audit GitHub workflow files under a repo path for action pinning. Finds every uses: reference, classifies it as PINNED (full 40-char SHA), MUTABLE (version tag), BRANCH, or LOCAL, labels the owner as official, third-party, docker, or local, and returns a PINNED, EXPOSED, or PARTIAL verdict with the file and line for every action.

path.description: Repo root, a .github/workflows directory, or a single workflow file

name: audit_workflows
